tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: The core brand navy. Mascot body on light grounds, primary buttons in light theme, headline ink.

tokens.name: brand-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest navy. Dark grounds, footer, the final call-to-action band.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Calm brand green for marks and fills only: the check-smile, the refresh antenna, step dots. Never small text on white (3.2:1).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green you can set text in: 'Guard' in the wordmark, inline links, eyebrow labels. 5.3:1 on surface (light), 7.9:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet success ground: the multi-site status rows, highlight bands. green-text on it reads 4.7:1 light / 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section background and card fills on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface and surface-alt (14.5:1 light, 14.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, captions, footer links on surface and surface-alt (≥6.3:1 light, ≥6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only; never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on an action fill (14.5:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: pass
tokens.usage: The 'Pass' badge fill and passed-check icons. Always paired with the word Pass.

tokens.name: on-pass
tokens.usage: Label on the pass fill (5.3:1 light, 7.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: fail
tokens.usage: Rolled-back / failed state. Always paired with the words 'Rolled back' — never color alone. 5.1:1 on white, 6.8:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every interactive element.
